problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 7 cargo shipments through 7 different port terminals.

Each shipment consists of a sequence of handling operations represented as (Terminal, Hours) pairs,
where each pair specifies the terminal where the operation must occur and the number of hours required.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the handling operations must be performed.

Shipment details:
* S1 requires the sequence: (T7, 7) → (T4, 8) → (T1, 9) → (T2, 4) → (T5, 6) → (T3, 1) → (T6, 1)
* S2 requires the sequence: (T4, 1) → (T2, 3) → (T1, 9) → (T7, 8) → (T3, 5) → (T6, 7) → (T5, 9)
* S3 requires the sequence: (T5, 10) → (T1, 6) → (T6, 5) → (T4, 2) → (T7, 1) → (T3, 4) → (T2, 10)
* S4 requires the sequence: (T7, 2) → (T1, 10) → (T5, 8) → (T3, 5) → (T6, 4) → (T2, 7) → (T4, 7)
* S5 requires the sequence: (T6, 1) → (T5, 3) → (T3, 6) → (T2, 10) → (T7, 10) → (T4, 8) → (T1, 2)
* S6 requires the sequence: (T5, 7) → (T4, 10) → (T6, 3) → (T3, 3) → (T2, 1) → (T1, 2) → (T7, 7)
* S7 requires the sequence: (T2, 5) → (T1, 6) → (T3, 10) → (T5, 4) → (T7, 9) → (T6, 9) → (T4, 1)

Each handling operation must run continuously once initiated and cannot be interrupted,
and each terminal can only accommodate one operation at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all operations across the terminals
so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
